placements.overview:
The Motherhood University placement report for 2025 and 2024 have not been released yet. The same will be updated here once released. However, the placement report 2023 is available. The highest package offered stood at INR 25 LPA. The average package offered was INR 7.49 LPA. In total, 446 students got placed and 26 companies visited the campus the placement drive. The notable recruiters such as MKD Group, Tech Mahindra, Just Dial, Bajaj Motors Ltd, etc. were part of Motherhood University placement drives 2023.

The Motherhood University has a dedicated placement cell that helps students in enhancing their skills. The cell provides technical and soft skill trainings to students. Industrial visits and interactive sessions with experts are conducted in a regular basis to keep the students engaged.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with everything.

review_content.Placements: The batch was so good. The 15 LPA package was the highest, and the 8 LPA package was the lowest. Some of the companies were ITC Gold Plus and Hero Honda. Most of the students were placed in the management and HR accounting. The internship was so good and so knowledgeable.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was also well managed. The facilities in the course in my department were so good, Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, and library, everything was so well managed, and there were no limitations in it. The classroom was so good that you just want to sit more and do not want to even leave.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The infrastructure is very good.

review_content.Placements: Paytm, ITC, and Axis Bank these are good of the top placements in my college, and students are very happy. Top MNCs are interviewing students and selecting students, with the maximum package is 15 LPA. Students who have passed college.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, games, canteen, medical hospital, sports events, and seminars all facilities are available in my college. It has very good infrastructure, and very good students are studying efficiently, acting quickly, and communicating good. Teachers are very good behavior.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good and helping faculty members.

review_content.Placements: B.Com does not show much placement opportunities but many other courses show many placement opportunities. The lowest average package is 4 LPA - 5 LPA. Most of the students got internship opportunities and further, they got a stipend and then a package at that company.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is good and environment is really healthy. There are AC and smart boards in classrooms. Hostels are very good and mess food is also good. They also have medical facilities for students in hostels. There is a canteen in the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. B.Ed (Integrated) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Infrastructure: 7/10, Teachers: 10/10, Canteen: 1/10, Students: 0/10, Exam: 7/10, Events: 7/10.

review_content.Placements: I hear from many seniors and recent graduates that the placement is not good because the examination process, or we can say the passing method, is very easy, so companies are not satisfied with Motherhood University students. The maximum salary is around 8 LPA, and only one or two students on average get very low salaries, like 20,000 to 30,000. However, if you study well, you can easily secure a higher package during placements at Motherhood University.
review_content.Infrastructure: Canteen structure: 3/10 because the canteen is in tin shades, leading to too much humidity and heat in summer. You can barely stay there for a single minute. Medical facilities: 6/10 because there is an Ayurvedic hospital in the university, but in emergencies or serious incidents, no one gets treatment; it's only good for fevers and headaches. Sports and games: 8/10, as there are many sports and games available, but there are no free lectures for playing these games.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Motherhood University.

review_content.Placements: Almost 90-95% of students got placed in this course. The highest salary package offered was 15 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 6 LPA. Around 70% of students got internships in this course. Top roles offered are corporate lawyer, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are not spacious. There is a decent library, and several books are available. Hostel facilities are great. Staff members are also friendly. The food served in the hostel is good. Medical facilities are average. Sports are conducted in this college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Law (LL.B.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: I have the best college and it gave me good knowledge and friends and a way to the good future.

review_content.Placements: The quality of placement of our college is good and reliable. Percentage of students placed every year is nearly 70%. The average salary package is near 6 Lacs per annum. Our college has a placement cell where different placements are available. Excellent placements and placement assistance is provided. Training is provided for aptitude and reasoning skills to crack the interviews. Several workshops are conducted to increase employability of the students.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college is the biggest campus college of Delhi University north campus it have different societies and 4 lawns too. Our college have a big library too where students study and read books in talk of sports our college have football basketball and other sports too.

review_summary.college_name: Motherhood University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with everything.

content.Placements: The batch was so good. The 15 LPA package was the highest, and the 8 LPA package was the lowest. Some of the companies were ITC Gold Plus and Hero Honda. Most of the students were placed in the management and HR accounting. The internship was so good and so knowledgeable.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was also well managed. The facilities in the course in my department were so good, Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, and library, everything was so well managed, and there were no limitations in it. The classroom was so good that you just want to sit more and do not want to even leave.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is very good.

content.Placements: Paytm, ITC, and Axis Bank these are good of the top placements in my college, and students are very happy. Top MNCs are interviewing students and selecting students, with the maximum package is 15 LPA. Students who have passed college.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, games, canteen, medical hospital, sports events, and seminars all facilities are available in my college. It has very good infrastructure, and very good students are studying efficiently, acting quickly, and communicating good. Teachers are very good behavior.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good and helping faculty members.

content.Placements: B.Com does not show much placement opportunities but many other courses show many placement opportunities. The lowest average package is 4 LPA - 5 LPA. Most of the students got internship opportunities and further, they got a stipend and then a package at that company.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is good and environment is really healthy. There are AC and smart boards in classrooms. Hostels are very good and mess food is also good. They also have medical facilities for students in hostels. There is a canteen in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. B.Ed (Integrated) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure: 7/10, Teachers: 10/10, Canteen: 1/10, Students: 0/10, Exam: 7/10, Events: 7/10.

content.Placements: I hear from many seniors and recent graduates that the placement is not good because the examination process, or we can say the passing method, is very easy, so companies are not satisfied with Motherhood University students. The maximum salary is around 8 LPA, and only one or two students on average get very low salaries, like 20,000 to 30,000. However, if you study well, you can easily secure a higher package during placements at Motherhood University.
content.Infrastructure: Canteen structure: 3/10 because the canteen is in tin shades, leading to too much humidity and heat in summer. You can barely stay there for a single minute. Medical facilities: 6/10 because there is an Ayurvedic hospital in the university, but in emergencies or serious incidents, no one gets treatment; it's only good for fevers and headaches. Sports and games: 8/10, as there are many sports and games available, but there are no free lectures for playing these games.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Motherhood University.

content.Placements: Almost 90-95% of students got placed in this course. The highest salary package offered was 15 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 6 LPA. Around 70% of students got internships in this course. Top roles offered are corporate lawyer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are not spacious. There is a decent library, and several books are available. Hostel facilities are great. Staff members are also friendly. The food served in the hostel is good. Medical facilities are average. Sports are conducted in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with everything.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was also well managed. The classroom was so good that you just want to sit more and do not want to even leave.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, games, canteen, medical hospital, sports events, and seminars all facilities are available in my college. It has very good infrastructure, and very good students are studying efficiently, acting quickly, and communicating good. Teachers are very good behavior.

reviews.review_heading: Good and helping faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is good and environment is really healthy. There are AC and smart boards in classrooms. Hostels are very good and mess food is also good. They also have medical facilities for students in hostels. There is a canteen in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure: 7/10, Teachers: 10/10, Canteen: 1/10, Students: 0/10, Exam: 7/10, Events: 7/10.
reviews.review_text: Canteen structure: 3/10 because the canteen is in tin shades, leading to too much humidity and heat in summer. You can barely stay there for a single minute. Medical facilities: 6/10 because there is an Ayurvedic hospital in the university, but in emergencies or serious incidents, no one gets treatment; it's only good for fevers and headaches. Sports and games: 8/10, as there are many sports and games available, but there are no free lectures for playing these games.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Motherhood University.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are not spacious. There is a decent library, and several books are available. Hostel facilities are great. Staff members are also friendly. The food served in the hostel is good. Medical facilities are average. Sports are conducted in this college.

reviews.review_heading: I have the best college and it gave me good knowledge and friends and a way to the good future.
reviews.review_text: Our college is the biggest campus college of Delhi University north campus it have different societies and 4 lawns too. Our college have a big library too where students study and read books in talk of sports our college have football basketball and other sports too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Motherhood University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was not available on our college campus. There were not many labs available. Classrooms were good. They had air-conditioning, a fan, and good furniture. The college also had a canteen where we could eat very good food. There were also medical and sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Motherhood University.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average. There are no air-conditioners in classrooms, and there are only fans. Classrooms are not that good, but the campus is lush green and beautiful. The college campus is the only part of the college, which I like the most, and students also like to hang out.

reviews.review_heading: In infrastructure and facilities, the university is really good.
reviews.review_text: We have all the necessary equipment like Wi-Fi, labs, hospital, mess, library, canteen, and medical facilities. Sports and games at the national level. The food in the mess is really healthy and amazing for every student. It is prepared with proper hygiene and served with lovely behavior.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with faculty and the placement rate.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi helps a lot in managing things, and the connection is good. Classrooms are overall okay. The library is not very well-stocked. Food is overall okay. The only way to manage here is by using the internet. Studying by yourself, cleaning your own dorm, maintaining yourself, and staying focused on your studies.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides a very good opportunity for students to make a career.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college has a very good canteen. It is behind the hostel. There are two hostels in our college. One for girls and the other for boys. Our college has a very good ground to play many games like cricket, badminton, football, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is decent in terms of money. But not that good.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, it is average in my college and in my course/department. There is no Wi-Fi for students. Classrooms are decent, library is also average, and the labs are decent. I'm not a hostel student, so I can't tell you about mess, but all other things are decent.

individual_reviews.title: College is good in terms of staff.

content.Placements: Since it is medical field the chances of placements depend upon whether the person has pursued higher degrees or not. If we have good degrees in post-graduate examinations we have good and plenty amount of chances of jobs. Internships are obviously part of the degree.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of this college is still in developing mode. Classrooms are good. Library is spacious and has good environment for studies. Hostel options are also available. This college has good canteen. For sports, we have separate areas especially badminton and table tennis courts.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college for students who are nearby and want to study.

content.Placements: Placement opportunities play a vital role in shaping careers offering students a platform to showcase their skills and gain industry exposure. They bridge the gap between academic knowledge and real world application to foster confidence and open doors rewarding professional growth.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure for both courses and hostels is thoughtfully designed, providing an excellent learning and living environment. We have state-of-the-art classrooms, well-equipped labs and libraries that enhance academic experiences while comfortable. Hostels are well-maintained to ensure a homely atmosphere, fostering growth and productivity.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Very good college for medical course with good faculty and good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Mahadevappa Rampura Medical College is a very repetitive college located in Gulbarga. Most of the doctors qualified from this college report that more than 50% of students will pass from the course and get a job.
content.Infrastructure: The faculty is good, and the teachers are very experienced, having completed both MBBS and MD. Both practical and theory classes are conducted, and the quality of the facilities, including the hostel, library, mess, canteen, and sports, is given importance.
content.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and qualified; they are knowledgeable. This course is related to the medical field, and students contribute to society through social service based on their knowledge. Semester exams are very easy to pass, but we have to study regularly.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty with a pretty average campus and basic infrastructure, with a good pass percentage.

content.Placements: It is a medical college. Most of the students prefer studying MD rather than working immediately after MBBS. This college has a compulsory 1-year internship as given by the board. This internship is paid. If we want to get placed and work immediately after MBBS, it is very easy to get a job in a hospital or set up a clinic.
content.Infrastructure: This college is a 70-year-old college with good and experienced faculty. It has some of the best doctors in the city for all the clinical subjects. It has limited infrastructure as it is an old campus. The hostel has average facilities. There are 2 canteens on the campus, one in the college and one in the hospital. There are sports and games on the campus, from indoor to outdoor. It has annual sports competitions and intercollege competitions.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Great faculty with poor facilities. Needs to focus on infrastructure maintenance and administration.

content.Placements: Placement rate is around average as not many opt for job immediately after MBBS and prepare for PG instead. Chances are you'll be taken up by clinics and small scale hospitals after MBBS to learn without much salary but getting experience instead. Skills taught by the college itself is not enough for landing a job and will have to go that extra mile with dedication to land a satisfactory one. Salaries range about 20,000 to 30,000 on starting and depends on your skill set.
content.Infrastructure: Not all classrooms are made the same with facilities. Only 3-4 can be classified as proper classrooms with comfortable benches. No Wi-Fi facility available for study/research. Library is spacious with too many books on display but only handful books from each subject are actually given to read. Not allowed to issue books outside library though. Boy’s hostel is absolutely worse. Infact calling it the worse is an understatement. Totally unhygienic and administration has given up. There's literally no mess or any other facility other than a single B.Ed in the room. Absolutely filthy bathrooms along with cobwebs since 2001.

highlights.summary: The GPAT 2026 application form for admission to the MPharma course is expected to be released during the first week of April 2026.

placements.overview: Established in 2009, Shri Ram Institute of Pharmacy is located in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. The institute offers courses like B.Pharma, M.Pharma and D.Pharma. These courses are offered in Full Time mode. A total of 6 courses offered by the Institute are available across stream such as Medicine & Health Sciences. The institute has all the necessary facilities to the students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Not the best infra but best for education.

review_content.Placements: Only 15% of students were placed this year. The highest package is 3 Lacs in B.Pharma. 15% of students got internships. Top roles are offered at my college. No top companies came, but students were not prepared. Faculty members tried their best, but sometimes students faced partiality.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities are average, not very good. Our pharmacy building is under construction. Labs are also not good, but okay. Classrooms are good. The exception is that hostels are not provided by the college. The canteen is very expensive, but its food quality is average. The games and sports facilities are excellent.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Pharma. in Pharmaceutics - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Review for my student life

review_content.Placements: From third semester students are eligible for campus placements. Pharma companies like Sanofi, Dr. Reddy' s Laboratories, Novartis, Lupin, Sun Pharma, Eli Lilly etc. The highest package is 28 lakhs per annum and the average package per company is 6 lakhs. Almost 75% of the students get placed, rest of them go for Phd's and business. My plan is to get placed in the upcoming campus placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: SRCT celebrate all kind of festivals like Ganesh Chathurthi, Saraswathi pooja, Navaratri, Christmas day celebration etc. NIPER also conducts SPANDAN every year in the month feb and march which include both the sports and cultutal activities. NIPER has wide range of accessiblity of books and jounals. It also has smart classrooms and seminar halls. NIPER has gym facilities, volleyball court , cricket ground, tennis court and shuttle court.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Our college is best for study but not for other facilities.

review_content.Placements: In the 12th class, if the average in the first division is 65 or above then your admission is confirmed. The highest salary package offered is 2.5 LPA. There is no rank of the company. Companies require the best communication skills and language for product selling.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library of our college is the best but sometimes, books are not available due to shortage of books. Students are delayed for study and preparing for exams. The canteen is average, not being specific. Facilities are best for studying.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Our college has good placements and good facilities.

review_content.Placements: About 40% to 59% of students get placed on our campus. According to their quality, the amount of the package is decided by them. Several companies have come to take the students. There are a large number of students who get internships from companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything is good in the college. Wi-Fi facilities are available on the whole campus at high speeds. A huge library is also there. The conditions of the labs are good enough. There are no hostels available on the college campus, but there are many PG houses available near the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: It has good teachers with excellent teaching quality but the infrastructure is average.

review_content.Placements: The placement percentage is very low. According to the placement cell, hardly 2 -3 out of 300 students get placed. Top recruiting companies include local and regional selection pharma companies. Roles were based on placement cell and also the ability of the student whether he will be qualified for these positions or not.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has an average infrastructure. There are good labs. Wi-Fi is not provided in classrooms. The library is fine. Other facilities like food and canteen are available. Medical facility is not as expected. Sports and games are wisely provided. I am satisfied with it but still, some work is needed.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Shri ram institute of pharmacy. Jabalpur Madhya Pradesh.

review_content.Placements: Many companies came to our college for campus selection. Almost 60% of students get internship programs. The average salary package offered by companies till now is 5 LPA - 6 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi-enabled campus is available but the speed is slow. All labs are available such as the biochemistry lab, microbiology lab, chemistry lab, and some others. A library is also available and has all the required books. Hostel is not provided by the college. Outside the college campus, there are a lot of private hostels available at reasonable prices. It has a good environment for studies with great facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities available. Would like improvements in the hostels.

review_content.Placements: Here we have a total class strength of 100 per batch in MBBS and 50 per batch in BDS. For a junior resident, the salary is 40k and for super specialties, itay reach 1.5 Lacs. Almost all the passed out students got internship from our college and get recruited either in government jobs like Medical officers or pursue PG in Management Quotas.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have seven lecture halls for theory classes. Practical halls for all the Pre and Para-Clinical subjects are available here. Library facilities are available. Hostels are not great but enough for us to survive. We have ample open space and fields to play any type s of games and sports. Mess is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with academic qualities, but lagging a little on extra curriculum.

review_content.Placements: 100 students are placed, which is around 9% of all qualified students from our state, in the NEET UG exam. They provide a 4-year course with a 9-month internship. We are not recruited by companies, we have to give interviews and exams at different hospitals for a job. All those who pass all 4 years have a chance for an internship. The director of the state's health department oversees this process.
review_content.Infrastructure: Lecture halls, classrooms, laboratories, wards, ICU, and OPD are available where we get to learn and have experience dealing with patients in all these departments. However, the water supply is poor, and we need personal storage cans. We are not allowed to use electric heaters in winter, and there are no induction cookers or rice cookers. There is no place for recreation and no room for indoor sports like table tennis. The gate closes at 8, which is too early if we want to study in the college library. The security leaves soon after closing gate, so we have to make a call every time we are late. The hostel food does not provide evening snacks.

content.Infrastructure: infrastructure of our college is well established. But, the hostel has not been open for the past 4 years. There is a library, canteen, and PG canteen are available. The mess food is quite good and AIQs friendly. They generally cook traditional Manipur dishes like Iromba, Nari, etc.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the infrastructure and facilities available. Would like improvements in the hostels.

content.Placements: Here we have a total class strength of 100 per batch in MBBS and 50 per batch in BDS. For a junior resident, the salary is 40k and for super specialties, itay reach 1.5 Lacs. Almost all the passed out students got internship from our college and get recruited either in government jobs like Medical officers or pursue PG in Management Quotas.
content.Infrastructure: We have seven lecture halls for theory classes. Practical halls for all the Pre and Para-Clinical subjects are available here. Library facilities are available. Hostels are not great but enough for us to survive. We have ample open space and fields to play any type s of games and sports. Mess is good.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with academic qualities, but lagging a little on extra curriculum.

content.Placements: 100 students are placed, which is around 9% of all qualified students from our state, in the NEET UG exam. They provide a 4-year course with a 9-month internship. We are not recruited by companies, we have to give interviews and exams at different hospitals for a job. All those who pass all 4 years have a chance for an internship. The director of the state's health department oversees this process.
content.Infrastructure: Lecture halls, classrooms, laboratories, wards, ICU, and OPD are available where we get to learn and have experience dealing with patients in all these departments. However, the water supply is poor, and we need personal storage cans. We are not allowed to use electric heaters in winter, and there are no induction cookers or rice cookers. There is no place for recreation and no room for indoor sports like table tennis. The gate closes at 8, which is too early if we want to study in the college library. The security leaves soon after closing gate, so we have to make a call every time we are late. The hostel food does not provide evening snacks.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I remember my course while practicing surgery.

content.Placements: There are more than 300 students studying this course in my college. Everyone is average of course. About 70% of students are recruited for surgery roles in hospitals and other firms. The role offered in my course is surgery. I am also good at surgical activities without any difficulties.
content.Infrastructure: In our classroom, free Wi-Fi is available. Also, labs and the library are also good. Students enjoy it a lot. Facilities of the canteen, medical, sports and games are also available in our compound. We are very happy to stay at JNIMS without any difficulties.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely the best college ever because they have internships to gain practical knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are best and campus of college is also well maintained. Facilities provided by the college are best quality, and education is given in the form of practical knowledge. Also, field visits are also organised by the college to ports, warehouse manufacturers' unit, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Garware Institute of Career Education and Development.
reviews.review_text:
We have a separate paint lab where we test and make paints and see certain parameters for manufacturing paints. We don't have a hostel specific to our college but there are hostels of Mumbai University. The food quality is very good and at a moderate price. We have a hospital in university and we get medical facilities free by showing a college ID card. 
There are events conducted not daily but 3 or 4 in a year.

reviews.review_heading: The course does have an elevating impact on our professional life.
reviews.review_text: GICED's infrastructure reflects a blend of tradition and modernity. While some facilities are well maintained, there's room for improvement in terms of upgrading technology, expanding resources, and enhancing overall accessibility to create an optimal learning environment.

reviews.review_heading: Best Place to Learn. Career will be good if you study here.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Canteen food is also good. College is surrounded by garden. Labs are also good. If anyone misses the practicals, they can repeat it. IT labs are also available. Good library with enough reference books is available.

reviews.review_heading: It has the best placements.
reviews.review_text: They don't have Wi-Fi for students. It is only for faculty members who work over there. It's great.

reviews.review_heading: GICED & BSS foundation both are doing a fantastic job in providing such good courses.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was full of facilities provided by the college and also the food available was of good quality and hygiene was maintained. Sports, games and other curricular activities was arranged by the college in specific intervals which kept the students motivated and energetic during the course.

reviews.review_heading: I am highly satisfied with this college. They provide good placements and makes us industry ready.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. They have Wi-Fi, Labs, Classrooms and Library. They also have computer lab. They also have average canteen facility. So I think they need to work on canteen facility. Classroom is very spacious. They also need to work on Wi-Fi facility. Sometimes Wi-Fi does not work properly.

reviews.review_heading: Garware Institute is one of the best institutions in Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: BMS in travel and tourism management is a 3-year full-time course. It has 6 semesters. We have a computer lab, classrooms with good seating arrangements and a library too. Garware has its own canteen, and the food is fresh and delicious. One can peacefully sit over there and enjoy their food.

reviews.review_heading: The institute is one of the best institutes in India, in terms of career.
reviews.review_text: The library and the paint lab are having good facilities, and the quality of the lab is good. The lab has the facilities of paint booth for painting objects or components, and the testing equipment which is generally used for after painting test and raw test painting. The campus canteen facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent and bravo industry, but you must have patience.
reviews.review_text: The institute is well developed. The canteen is good. There are no air-conditioners in every classroom, but they are good. It also has audio room. The computer labs are also there as well as the library is big. As well as every classroom has projectors and faculty is also very good and experienced in the field.

reviews.review_heading: Mixed Bag: Excellent Facilities, Poor Faculty Despite Strong Placement Record.
reviews.review_text: High-speed Wi-Fi access throughout the building, well-equipped specialized labs for hands-on learning, modern classrooms with audio-visual aids, and a well-stocked library offering a diverse collection of relevant textbooks, journals, and digital resources.

reviews.review_heading: Mumbai University is great to study.
reviews.review_text: Mumbai University infrastructure is quite impressive. The university has two campuses: the Kalina Campus and the Fort Campus. The Kalina Campus is the main campus and spans over 230 acres, boasting modern infrastructure, including state-of-the-art laboratories, libraries, and computer centers .

reviews.review_heading: Highly dissatisfied because of faculty, but placements opportunities are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is been overlooked by staff and college. There are no proper benches. Lab facilities and libraries need to be developed. Medical facilities are good that I can guarantee. Food is average but the canteen food is good.

reviews.review_heading: All about MUMBAI UNIVERSITY.
reviews.review_text: Mumbai University infrastructure is the topclass infrastructure and they provide hostels, playground, for the students to get rid of the stress and anxiety you'll get the opportunity for best games and other facilities. You can play many games and participate in the games as well.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the course exams and placement and all it's amazing.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are amazing and they do have big space to do studies near university. Labs and other facilities are also available for other courses which is essential and everything is perfect and faculty members are also helpful they do help us in studies and cooperative tooLabs and other facilities are also available for other courses which is essential and everything is perfect and faculty members are also helpful they do help us in studies and cooperative too.
